## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the concrete problem and what this change does. Identify native, legacy, or documentation scope.

## Validation

List checks and outcomes. Separate host tests from device observations and state what was not run.

## Compatibility and limitations

Note affected APIs, architectures, users, signing / migration behavior, or remaining uncertainty where relevant.

## Checklist

- [ ] Changes are focused and related documentation is current.
- [ ] Relevant checks are recorded above.
- [ ] No private identifiers, device evidence, credentials, or signing keys are included.
- [ ] Applicable license notices and dependency provenance are preserved.
